items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: I know that Paul was an excellent saxophone player, and there's no question about Lester Young.

ctx.x: There was another tenor saxophone player, Paul Jones. There was Buster McPherson, an alto player -- he was a very good alto player. Paul Jones was the leading tenor player in town, and he used to battle with all the tenor saxophonists that came in town -- guys like, you know, Chu Berry and Ben Webster and all of them would come in there. In those days guys would come in looking for Paul Jones, or he'd be looking for them, or one of those kind of things. They'd have really these friendly battles. And they'd really…
